prompt_text:
The first image shows three crops of ONE target person at different times. The other image(s) show comparison people from the SAME video; every labeled tile is a different annotated person, shown in up to three crops. These comparison labels are anonymous bookkeeping labels, not appearance attributes.
Write one concise English noun phrase (at most 30 words), starting with "the person", describing the target using stable, clearly visible clothing, patterns, hair, or accessories. Prefer details that distinguish this person from comparison people. Do not mention actions, pose, scene location, time, spatial relation to others, gallery labels, or GT identity numbers. Visible garment lettering is allowed only if clearly legible. Do not infer colors/details hidden by another person. If no reliable description is possible, use an empty phrase. If a truthful description is shared by others, still provide it and set visually_distinct to false.
Return {"phrase":"...", "supported_attributes":["..."], "visually_distinct":true, "limitations":"..."}. A description need not be unique; truthful uncertainty is preferred to invented uniqueness.
The target person is also included once among the comparison gallery tiles. Identify that repeated target visually; do not treat the repeated target tile as a different rival. Look for truthful stable appearance that distinguishes the target from OTHER people.

message.content:
{
  "phrase": "the person wearing a black top with a red belt, black wide-leg pants, bright pink shoes, and a silver chain with large rings hanging from the waist",
  "supported_attributes": [
    "black top",
    "red belt",
    "black wide-leg pants",
    "bright pink shoes",
    "silver chain with large rings"
  ],
  "visually_distinct": true,
  "limitations": "The chain with large rings is a key distinguishing feature, but some other dancers also wear similar chains; however, the combination of the chain, red belt, and pink shoes is consistently visible and matches the target across all views."
}
